city.title: Asterhaven

places.name: Marlowe Hall
places.text: Main dorm: five floors, basement laundry, common room on the ground floor. {{user}} lives in room 218 with Juno.

places.name: Dorm Building 2
places.text: Second residence block (name to be decided).

places.name: Dorm Building 3
places.text: Third residence block (name to be decided).

places.name: Student Apartments
places.text: Shared three- and four-storey blocks with thin walls and clanking radiators.

places.name: Asterhaven University (campus)
places.text: Lecture halls, labs, library, Student Union, glasshouse, pool, radio. Ten minutes on foot from Marlowe Hall.

places.name: Tideglass Books
places.text: Used bookstore. Owner Ezra Quill. Closed around 7 PM.

places.name: Kettle & Ladle Noodle Bar
places.text: Eight stools, four tables, chalkboard menu. Owner Hanae Okabe. Riko rents a room above a shop on the same street.

places.name: The Salt Lantern
places.text: Harbor bar with lanterns and a long counter. Open late afternoon to about 2 AM. Cassian lives in the flat above.

places.name: Promenade & Docks
places.text: Wide waterfront walk with benches and viewpoints. The docks at the east end handle fishing boats and small cargo.

places.name: Ashcroft Shipping & Penthouse
places.text: Family shipping firm: offices and warehouses; the penthouse overlooks the harbor.

places.name: Asterhaven General Hospital
places.text: Seven floors, Emergency Department, clinics. Line 4 stops here.

places.name: Odette's flat
places.text: Small rented flat that smells of baking. Two cats.

places.name: Corvane University (off the map)
places.text: A different town, too far to commute. Setting of Mirel's route only.

travel: Marlowe Hall to the University Quarter: 10 min on foot
Student Residential District to Old Town: 15-20 min on foot, 5 by bus
Old Town to the Harborfront: 10 min on foot
University Quarter to the Harborfront: 20 min on foot, 8 by bus
University Quarter to the hospital: 12 min by bus. Old Town to the hospital: 15 by bus
Harbor Line every 12 min until midnight. Line 4 serves the neighborhoods and hospital. Night Owl hourly until about 2:30 AM

places.name: Main Gate & bus stop
places.text: Harbor Line stop. Marlowe Hall is a 10-minute walk west.

places.name: Administration Building
places.text: Housing office (slow) and registrar.

places.name: University Library
places.text: Reading rooms, silent floors, rare-books room, folklore stacks. Open late in exam periods.

places.name: Physics Building & Observatory Dome
places.text: Dome on the roof (key from the physics department). Open nights on clear Fridays.

places.name: University Glasshouse
places.text: Victorian glass-and-iron botanical garden behind the science buildings.

places.name: Brine Hall (Humanities)
places.text: Stone faculty building with ship models in the corridors. Goldie's office is on the third floor.

places.name: Student Union, Lantern Lounge & WAST
places.text: Student Union Office (first floor), Lantern Society lounge (invitation only), WAST 88.1 radio in the basement.

places.name: Campus Cafe
places.text: On the quad. Strong coffee, pastries, lunch queue.

places.name: Science & Lecture Halls
places.text: Lecture halls and laboratories.

places.name: Marine Biology Lab
places.text: Tanks, microscopes, a cold room.

places.name: University Pool
places.text: Fifty-metre indoor pool with a viewing gallery. Swim team practice 6-8 AM; open swim in the evenings.

exits.label: To Marlowe Hall and the Student Residential District (10 min)
Harbor Line to Old Town and Harborfront

buildings.name: Marlowe Hall
buildings.sub: Student Residential District, five floors, co-ed
buildings.text: 1960s brick building. Small elevator, usually out of service. Quiet hours 11 PM to 7 AM. Roof locked. Thursday is floor pizza night.
